notes: Only the first isnad (to al-Husayn) is read. The report carries several further sayings with their own chains (Muhammad b. al-Hanafiyya, Zayn al-Abidin, Zayd b. Ali, Wahb's Baqir report), so it is flagged rather than split.
«قال الباقر: حدثني أبي» makes Baqir a link mid-chain (rule 5), kept as narrator, not imam_in_text.
«أبي زين العابدين» and «أبيه الحسين بن علي» are each one name (rule 7). «أحمد بن بن شجاع» is copied as written.
